about_the_game:
Buckle up and soar to new heights in Airplane Racing Championship – the ultimate high-speed aerial racing experience! Compete against elite pilots in stunning environments, from bustling cityscapes to treacherous mountain, Beach, Many More. Master your aircraft, pull off daring stunts, and dominate the leaderboard in this adrenaline-fueled race through the skies.

Features:

-Intense Airplane Races: Compete in fast-paced races with AI opponents.

-7 different Aircrafts for the player to choose from. (2 Aircrafts available in Demo Version)

-12 Challenging Tracks are offered to the players. After each challenge difficulty increases. (2 Tracks available in Demo Version)

-Suitable for all age group.

Whether you're a casual flyer or a die-hard racing fan, Airplane Racing Championship delivers heart-pounding aerial action like never before. Lets become the ultimate sky racer!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 6600K
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 2 GB Nvidia GTX 970 Graphic Card
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Later
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700K
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 8GB NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 or above
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
